title: Cosplay Competition At the Stage
content: I recently had a dream last night that multiple people were participating in a cosplay contest at a large comic-con event. The “stage” changes its vibes for me often but this was at a stage. The MC/hostess who was running the event tried to disqualify me for my costume. At that point, everyone knew she was a corrupt authority “dream figure”. I have this power in dreams where I can zoom around different perspectives. All of a sudden I was a member of the audience, loudly BOO-ing the lady who tried to disqualify the “other me”. Anyways, I was booing for a while until the lady was defeated and I woke up. Curious if anyone has dreams like this!
